create_PagerDutyAlerting: create a PagerDutyAlerting instance with custom failure and hanging threshold configuration
trigger_PagerDuty_alert_failure: trigger a PagerDuty alert when LLM API failure rate exceeds the configured threshold in a time window
detect_hanging_LLM_requests: detect hanging LLM requests that exceed the configured hanging threshold seconds
send_PagerDuty_critical_alert: send a critical PagerDuty alert with a summary message and custom details via the Events API v2
summarize_recent_errors: summarize the last N recent error events for inclusion in PagerDuty alert details
